name: zotero-word-live-citations
description: Find papers, match them to your Zotero Desktop library, import missing items with approval, and write live Zotero citation fields into Word DOCX files.

interface.shortDescription: Live Zotero citation fields in Word documents
interface.longDescription: Search the literature, resolve references against your local Zotero library, import missing items after you approve, and insert real ADDIN ZOTERO_ITEM / ZOTERO_BIBL fields into a copy of your DOCX that Zotero's Word plugin can refresh.
defaultPrompt: Add Zotero citations for these references to my manuscript.docx
Find papers supporting each claim in draft.md and produce a Word file with live Zotero citations
Check whether report.docx contains valid Zotero citation fields
